title: Canyon Circuit
description: Drift, boost and jump through a vast sunlit canyon in a fast low-poly arcade racer. Race two AI rivals, battle a friend in split-screen, build tracks in the Track Lab, or chase up to three online ghosts.

defaultCaptions.x: Charged drifts, perfect boost pads and trick landings through a giant sunlit canyon. Every car is equal — only your line matters. Play Canyon Circuit in your browser.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Canyon Circuit is a fast low-poly arcade racer: three laps, 16 gates a lap, equal cars and pure skill. Race AI rivals, a friend in split-screen, or online ghosts.
defaultCaptions.reddit: Canyon Circuit — a browser arcade racer with charged drifts, slipstream, ramps and fair counterplay items. Solo, split-screen, Track Lab and online ghosts.
defaultCaptions.discord: Race me in Canyon Circuit! Equal cars, big canyon, online ghost rooms for up to three players.
